description: OpenCode plugin: measure-guard for OpenCode 2 (server and terminal parts), Measure agents, commands, installer targets, and documents
deviation_notes: 39 of the 48 plan tasks are done; the 9 'User Manual Verification' tasks stay [b] deferred:owner. Deviations: the live checks used the service HTTP API because `opencode run` hung on this machine (decision 9); the install layout changed twice (plugins-folder entry file, then root index.ts and tui.ts, after reading the host's resolver); the end-of-turn check triggers on session.execution.* events because session.idle never reached the plugin (decision 10); guard-mode reminders and command replies are synthetic messages with resume: false, delivered with the next prompt; notes go into result.content because the shell tool leaves output empty; `multiedit` does not exist in 2.0.32 but stays in the tool list. Four fix commits outside the task list (test type, turn-end events, root entries, closeout test type).

sprint.goal: An OpenCode user gets the same Measure guard rails as a Claude Code user: the plan state is visible, work outside the active plan is stopped, the Measure commands and roles are one keystroke away, and the installer keeps every copy current.
sprint.demo_notes: Live on OpenCode 2.0.32: a write without a [~] task was denied with the editDecision text; the prompt carried the task note; a file changed during a turn produced the end-of-turn reminder and the state file; /measure-off, /measure-on, /measure-guard replied; measure_status answered through code mode; the terminal showed the band above the prompt; the installer test and --check list the new targets.
